behavior: A user signs up once and owns their profiles: POST/GET /v1/me and POST /v1/profiles
acceptance: POST /v1/me with a valid token for a new user creates the user, a personal profile and its wallet; calling it again changes nothing; GET /v1/me lists profiles with kind, name and wallet address

POST /v1/profiles with an Idempotency-Key creates a freelancer or merchant profile with its own wallet; another user's token gets 403 on every profile route (tested across users); openapi.yaml describes the routes
notes: 2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: Independent review: ownership, idempotency (per-user keys, concurrent same key), signup once, 403 across users and error mapping verified by reading code and running go test -race. Four low findings fixed and rechecked: NUL in name now 422 (tested), ProfileWallet bounded by privy.Timeout 20s (tested), api.md names the POST /v1/me key exception, signup user+personal insert in one transaction. No blocking issues.

proof.1: backend: profile tests TestSignUpOnce, TestSignUpConcurrently, TestSignUpRetriesAFailedWallet and httpapi TestSignUpAndMe: POST /v1/me makes the user, personal profile and wallet once (201 then 200, same body), GET /v1/me lists kind, name, walletAddress
proof.2: backend: TestCreateProfile, TestCreateProfileSameKeyConcurrently, TestCreateProfileRoute (201/200/409/400/422/404) and TestProfilesBelongToTheirUser (Bob gets 403 on every route in profileRoutes for each of Alice's profiles, never sees them in /v1/me); openapi.yaml validated with redocly lint
